stamp_verification: 845 tests; 10 SHIP / 1 REDIRECT / 0 fail. Render: every section was printing its own teaser sentence twice (~24-31 duplicate lines per org, now gone); a nav line chopped mid-word with no ellipsis; a literal · reached the client; a hardcoded 'Positions 6 - 25' contradicted the rows. Consistency: one definition of 'needs attention' now drives the call list, the watchlist, the hero at-risk card and the footer — hfg's watchlist drops from 10 dealers/$1.90M (incl. +83.9% and +1.8% accounts) to 6/$0.84M, and the footer no longer cites grow/flat rows that do not exist.
description: V12 expands the freeze from 4 orgs to all 11 runnable ones. The V11 set (sarreid, cci, da, clc) could not detect Sarreid overfit because it contained only orgs that behave like Sarreid; hfg/kal/ali/sca were dropped from V11 rather than reviewed, and bsc/bmc/bri were never frozen at all. bsc is now the ONLY regression coverage of the correct-refusal path. A golden set is a CHANGE DETECTOR, not a quality certificate: `known_defects` per org records the design debt frozen alongside each baseline so Phases 4-10 can tick it off. Nothing in known_defects is endorsed by being frozen.
